basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old retail worker currently navigating the ups and downs of life in the Midwest, USA. After moving back in with my parents due to the pandemic, I found myself facing a grueling 45-minute commute to my job at Walmart. I've always been interested in personal finance and enjoy exploring ways to make my money work for me. When I'm not working, you can find me catching up on the latest podcasts or scrolling through Reddit late into the night. I'm single and still figuring things out, but I'm hopeful about the future.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge largely stems from personal experiences and online research. Working in retail has taught me a lot about customer service and business operations. I also spend a lot of time on subreddits related to personal finance and retail work, learning from others’ experiences.
